checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Same overall features and proportions; eyes slightly more defined, lips slightly fuller/redder, but recognisable.
Visible freckles and texture remain, no airbrushing; slightly more freckles than the source.

must.item: Curly dark hair and expression remain
must.why: Hair length and curls preserved; same calm slight smile.

must.item: Park replaced with unobtrusive backdrop, flattering lighting
must.why: Plain soft-grey backdrop, even studio lighting.

faults.what: Slight drift: added freckles, more defined eyes and brows, more saturated lips; the image looks a bit more retouched or generated than the source.
Stray flyaway hairs and a slightly cut-out hair edge against the backdrop.

summary: A clean professional headshot with blazer and grey studio backdrop that keeps her likeness, curls and skin texture, with only minor drift such as extra freckles and slightly enhanced eyes and lips.
